_meta.principle: Maps syntax to core nodes only. Adapter logic (heuristics, symbols) is excluded.
_meta.changelog_1.6: Added Field, Constant, TestCase node mappings. Added has_field, references, listens_to, defines_variable, defines_constant, defines_field, contains_field, contains_constant edge mappings. Schema 1.3 -> 1.4.

route_registrations._doc: Config-driven URL route extraction. Each framework declares how it registers a route so the builder stays generic. Django: path/re_path/url(pattern, view, name=NAME) with a module-level app_name namespace.

include_registrations._doc: Config-driven URLconf include-tree extraction (framework-agnostic). Each framework declares how it includes a sub-URLconf so the builder stays generic. Django: path(prefix, include('module.path'), namespace='ns'?). A LITERAL module string -> an includes_urlconf edge (File->File) to the resolved module; a literal namespace= is carried as edge metadata. A non-literal module arg (variable / inline include([...]) list) -> an unresolved_include ambiguity, never a guess. Empty {} = off, graph unchanged.

model_form_binding._doc: Config-driven form/serializer -> model binding (framework-agnostic). A class extending a configured base (Django forms.ModelForm / DRF ModelSerializer) with a nested Meta class whose model attr names a Model -> a uses_model edge (Form Class -> Model Class), resolved by name (heuristic). A non-literal model attr -> an unresolved_model_binding ambiguity. Structural detection (a base class + a nested attr), like the TestCase/Field policy. Empty {} = off.

signal_receivers._doc: Config-driven signal receiver detection (framework-agnostic). A function decorated @receiver(SIGNAL, ...) -> a listens_to edge (Function -> Signal), the Signal named by the decorator's signal arg (a Name/Attribute; joined to a Signal node by name at merge). A non-name signal arg -> an unresolved_signal ambiguity. Structural detection (a decorator), like the route/testcase policy. Empty {} = off.

header_event_dispatch._doc: Config-driven GENERIC inline HTMX event dispatch (no project helper needed). A direct response-header assignment response[HEADER] = <literal> dispatches a client-side event: a bare string literal (optionally comma-separated) -> one event per name; json.dumps({'evt': ...}) with a DICT LITERAL -> one event per literal key. Emits dispatches_event (enclosing Function/Method -> Event, joined to the JS listener by name at merge). A computed value (a variable / a non-literal dict) -> an unresolved_hx_trigger ambiguity, never a guess. A framework fact (the HX-Trigger header names), not a project helper -> shippable by default. Empty {} = off.

call_couplings._doc: From a Python call: {func: literal_arg_index}, a target node type + match strategy + edge. match: node_name (an existing/placeholder node by exact name), template_suffix (a Template by path suffix).
